## `extract_persons_dr_standalone` 💣

**F1:** 0.590 | **Precision:** 0.947 | **Recall:** 0.428  

**Format:** `regex`  
**Rule ID:** `9d05d5b9`  
**Description:**

## `extract_persons_with_dr` 

**F1:** 0.004 | **Precision:** 0.800 | **Recall:** 0.002  

**Format:** `regex`  
**Rule ID:** `a195664b`  
**Description:**

## `extract_persons_with_kommr_kzlr` 💣

**F1:** 0.003 | **Precision:** 0.462 | **Recall:** 0.001  

**Format:** `regex`  
**Rule ID:** `19b2b74f`  
**Description:**
Matches persons with 'KommR' or 'KzlR' titles, ensuring the full name is captured including hyphenated surnames.

**Content:**
```
(?<!\w)(KommR(?:\s+KommR)?\s+|KzlR\s+)([A-Z][a-z\u00e4\u00f6\u00fc\u00df\u00e9\u00e8\u00ea\u00eb]+(?:\s+[A-Z][a-z\u00e4\u00f6\u00fc\u00df\u00e9\u00e8\u00ea\u00eb]+)*(?:-[A-Z][a-z\u00e4\u00f6\u00fc\u00df\u00e9\u00e8\u00ea\u00eb]+)*(?:\s+LL\.M\.)?)(?!\s*(?:Ltd|GmbH|AG|OG|KG|Rechtsanw\u00e4lte|Partnerschaft|&\s*Dr\.)\b)
```
